title: Look Up Member Profile and Savings Balance
description: Retrieves a member's full name, membership status, and current savings balance given their member number.
goal: Look up member {member_number} and read their full name, membership status, and current savings balance

inputs.name: member_number
inputs.description: The member number to look up.

outputs.name: membership_status
outputs.description: The current status of the membership.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: The member's current savings account balance.

outcomes.description: No member exists with the given member number.
The member exists but has no savings account on file.
outcomes.signal_text: No savings account found for this member

outcomes.description: The operator does not have rights to view this member's details.
